snippet.title: Tiny Crate / Puzzle Action Trailer
snippet.description:
Harmony Monroe Discord - https://discord.gg/qGKzEykNyA
Tiny Crate on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3733440/Tiny_Crate/

Harmony Monroe Website - http://harmonymonroe.com
Harmony Monroe Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/harmonymonroe.bsky.social

Tiny Crate is a cute little Block Puzzle Precision Platfomer!
Lift and toss crates to traverse over spike pits and reach higher ground!
Weigh down buttons to create platforms and solve the puzzle!
Push yourself and make tight jumps! You got this! (:

Tiny Crate is Free and Open Source! - https://github.com/HarmonyHoney/tiny_crate

Tiny Crate started life as PICO-CRATE, a PICO-8 Game! - https://harmonyhoney.itch.io/pico-crate

HHoney Software - http://hhoney.net
Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/hhoneysoft.bsky.social
